[p. 25] Definitions for Terms in Requirements VM-01 
 
© 2025 National Association of Insurance Commissioners 01-1 VM-01: Definitions for Terms in Requirements 
VM-01 provides definitions for terms used in the Valuation Manual . 
 
• The term “accident and health insurance” means contracts that incorporate morbidity risk and provide protection against economic loss resulting from accident, sickness or medical conditions. (Model #820 definition.)
• The term “appointed actuary” means a qualified actuary who is appointed or retained to prepare the statement of actuarial opinion.
• The term “cash surrender value” means the amount available in cash upon surrender of an insurance policy.
• The term “valuation manual” means the manual of valuation instructions adopted by the NAIC.
